verdict.rationale: Docs imply Devin works directly on codebases (implementing features, fixing bugs, migrations) and can query GitHub repositories including private ones with authentication, which presupposes a connected repo, but no evidence pack item explicitly describes the GitHub connection/authorization flow or confirms Devin opens pull requests as an output. missing for 10: explicit documentation of GitHub repo connection setup and PR-creation workflow, independent confirmation that PRs are actually opened by the agent.
